request_text: Fix #6233 structurally: clone-local-effect upgrade migrations are stranded by the tracked metadata.yaml ledger. Add a clone_local_effect class attribute on BaseMigration folded into reselect_when_recorded so a recorded clone-local migration reselects when its own detect() still reports the effect absent; tag the ~10 clone-local migrations (exclude_spec_kitty, exclude_worktrees, install_lane_tip_recorder, the merge-driver seeding base + subclasses). Red-first regression tests + idempotency gate + ADR note.
